changes.title: Make newly enabled Cleric spell buttons tappable
changes.text: Restore touch input when increasing the number of spell buttons so empty positions open their picker.

changes.title: Keep simultaneous statistics cache writes separate
changes.text: Give each row and fact cache writer its own temporary file so overlapping writes cannot discard another completed cache.

changes.title: Test touches after expanding Cleric spell slots
changes.text: Use real pointer taps on empty positions 2–4 after increasing from one button, and capture the picker and stack.

changes.title: Show Cleric selected in the lore check
changes.text: Select Cleric before capturing its verified first-run message.

changes.title: Reproduce overlapping cache writers
changes.text: Force two row-cache writers and two fact-cache writers to overlap and verify a complete cache and temporary-file cleanup.

changes.title: Deliver the owner's complete lore collection PDF
changes.text: Provide a verified private PDF download covering all 50 existing entries and their collection conditions.

changes.title: Retain verified checkpoints and reliability evidence
changes.text: Record exact build results, the touch correction and the separately reproduced cache race without claiming physical-phone verification.

commentary: I fixed the newly enabled Cleric spell buttons so they accept taps instead of only appearing on screen. I also protected optional statistics caches against overlapping writes; player history and spell mechanics are preserved.
